# Test targets whose results do not depend on the operating system.
#
# On pushes to `dev` and on pull requests that do not target `release`, CI
# runs these targets only on the Linux runner that runs every test. Every
# other runner runs the library and binary unit tests, every test target
# that is not listed here, and the tests named below. Pull requests into
# `release`, pushes to `release` and the weekly run still run every test on
# every OS.
#
# A test target that is not listed here runs on every OS, so a new target is
# platform-dependent until it is listed. List a target only when none of its
# tests touch paths, file permissions or files on disk, processes or
# signals, locks, the terminal, the system clock or time zones, line
# endings, or `#[cfg(windows)]` / `#[cfg(unix)]` code. When a listed target
# has a few tests that do, name them below the target so they keep running
# on every OS.
#
# Format:
#   <package> <test target>              the target is platform-independent
#   <package> <test target> <test name>  this test still runs on every OS

# Aggregation, parsing and rendering without files or the system time zone.
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios
# Named time zones, daylight saving time and local day boundaries.
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios combined_report_aggregates_match_the_individual_calculations
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios created_and_merged_on_different_tokyo_days
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios empty_activity_reports_zero_everywhere
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios fall_back_day_has_25_hours_and_keeps_its_events
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios issue_opened_counts_on_its_creation_day_in_the_zone
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios merge_in_a_later_period_is_not_counted_at_creation
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios reviews_land_on_their_submission_days
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios spring_forward_day_has_23_hours_and_keeps_its_events
ghusage-core aggregation_scenarios tokyo_and_utc_put_a_boundary_commit_on_different_days
ghusage-core detail_rows
ghusage-core diff_stats
ghusage-core pr_commits
ghusage-core thread_replies

# GraphQL and REST parsing, pagination and retries against a local mock server.
ghusage-github commit
ghusage-github debug_log
ghusage-github http
ghusage-github live
ghusage-github pagination_properties
ghusage-github pull_request
ghusage-github repos
ghusage-github search

# Reports computed from a scratch cache.
ghusage-app reports

# Terminal UI screens rendered into an in-memory buffer.
ghusage-tui commits
ghusage-tui details
ghusage-tui navigation
ghusage-tui screens
# The 100,000-event latency check runs on one runner only.
ghusage-tui performance

# End-to-end sync and reports against a local mock server.
ghusage e2e_reports
# A time zone option, and whether a cache file is left on disk.
ghusage e2e_reports repo_and_timezone_options_change_the_report
ghusage e2e_reports no_cache_reports_match_cached_reports_and_leave_no_database
ghusage e2e_sync
# A second process holding the sync lock, and terminal control characters.
ghusage e2e_sync a_report_during_another_sync_still_shows_the_cache
ghusage e2e_sync untrusted_text_is_sanitized_in_tables_and_escaped_in_json
